beats.headline: The house gets a name
beats.text: The world rumbles while Mordecai goes to check on something, and Louis says he hopes the Twister is okay. That's what they named the house, Firas explains, and it's parked right outside of town. Louis wanted to call it the Tiddy Twister II, but Firas told him they're trying to be more mature, and Katia wouldn't let them. The original Tiddy Twister was Louis's van. Carl says he thought it was Louis's mom's van.

beats.headline: Riding the storm
beats.text: Donut's Heal Critter says she is too far away from Orthrus, so Carl sends Louis and Firas out to the Twister in the storm and tells Donut to meet them there. Up in the house she casts it, and it works. The house is breaking up, Louis reports; the balloon is slamming back and forth like a bull. It lands with its net ripped to pieces, holes in the yard and water arcing from a severed main. It will fall out of the sky if they don't fix it, Louis calls. Carl looks at the garage.

beats.headline: Off the edge of the yard
beats.text: With nowhere to take off, Carl talks Louis and Firas into flying the house out over the ocean near the edge of the bubble, so the plane can drop off the edge of the Twister. They pull the drop bear out of the large garage and face it into the wind. Louis lowers the balloon onto the breeze from outside the bubble, and it speeds up. The little biplane rolls off the edge of the yard and drops like a rock until Carl pulls up. The Twister descends back toward the pazuzu village.

beats.headline: Through the portal
beats.text: Carl doesn't want Louis and Firas leaving bubble 543 and risking the Twister before they have to; if anything happens to the balloon, it screws everything up. When it goes, the journey to Imani and Elle's world is uneventful, changelings coasting alongside as geese. Mordecai insists the portal will not let crawlers pass from floor to floor, so the Twister goes through with the changelings to the sixth floor, without Louis and Firas, who will take the regular stairwell and hope to recover the flying house. Louis frets on chat: Skarn is a good pilot but a little shit, and Bonnie wants to install some upgrades.

beats.headline: A ballista in the yard
beats.text: Louis and Firas have recovered the Twister from the changeling refugees, and Bonnie went with the refugees. Before she did, Firas says, she built a giant crossbow, a ballista, out of the mechanism for the garage door opener and fixed it to the side of the yard. Katia test-fired it, and it blew up a tree. But the ceiling on this floor is low: the balloon is too big to get over the trees, so the house is not very useful.

beats.headline: Weedkiller from the deck
beats.text: Louis's Extermination Professional class has an ability called Tent the House, which delivers a potion over a wide area, wider still cast from the deck of the Twister, once every six hours. Loaded with Mordecai's weedkiller, Katia and the others move in on an Odious Creeper using the Twister, and the kill is credited to Crawler Louis Santiago 2, who is not sure he can stomach that again. By the time fifteen more creepers have fallen, Louis has killed three.

beats.headline: Taken by the mantises
beats.text: The ground rumbles with one of Carl's bombs dropped from the Twister; a spotlight finds the airship, and the bomb meant for the mounted elves misses. Then Louis comes running: the mantises have taken the Twister, the changelings have turned to birds and left, and the Sledge had to jump. Sledge has the controller, and Bonnie, the bear cubs and Prudence are okay. Bombs still dangling, he says he can crash the Twister into the other turrets, like a helicopter in GTA. Don't crash the Twister, Louis begs. Carl tells him to do it.

beats.headline: Got both
beats.text: In the queen's chamber, the whole palace shakes with one explosion, then a second, louder one, and acorns fall from the inverted tree like hail. Sledge reports in: guard turrets get good, Twister house blow up, got both. Louis wails. Surviving is winning, Louis, Sledge tells him. Everything else is bullshit.
